purpose: 画笔玩法讨论用AI概念图；不是已实现功能
prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high quality landscape game interaction concept board with THREE large portrait mobile gameplay panels left to right, a small title and concise Chinese annotations on warm ivory paper margins. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for this existing game, not an edit target. Preserve its aesthetic: Chinese folk paper-cut shadow theatre, flat layered cut paper, ivory sky, enormous vermilion sun, angular rust-red mountains, charcoal battlefield, delicate antique gold details, small white fox with red markings fixed in the lower-middle. Simplify HUD to health, ink, and small concept-specific action prompt; remove developer test buttons and clutter. Same camera, same fox, same enemy placement evolving logically across the three frames. Enemy silhouettes are black-red paper demons. Player stroke must be visible and slightly imperfect bright cinnabar with a tiny gold brush tip/touch dot, NOT a realistic hand. Physical folds, paper edges, cut-out ornamental patterns, restrained graphic effects. This is a reviewable gameplay storyboard, NOT a marketing poster. Only short legible Chinese captions. Explicitly distinguish hand-drawn marks from the polished cut-paper result. The player's exact spatial input must remain traceable across panels. No photorealism, no 3D, no anime portrait, no giant UI cards, no English lorem ipsum. Title "方案 A · 一笔游龙". Core mechanic: in a charged ultimate mode, the player freely draws ONE winding open line THROUGH enemy groups. This is a dragon SPINE/PATH, NOT an attempt to draw animal anatomy. Panel 1 label "画龙脊": a naturally asymmetric S-shaped red brush path passes through three separated enemy groups in the upper battlefield, start near the fox, end at upper-right; most of path remains thin visibly hand drawn, small dragon head preview emerges at the moving gold tip. A tiny explanatory inset in the margin shows the same irregular path and text "画的是路线". Panel 2 label "纸龙沿笔展开": the EXACT same S-shaped path now has beautiful red and antique-gold segmented cut-paper dragon body unfurling along it, deliberate gaps show former path, a majestic but legible dragon head at the path's end. Dragon must follow the irregular curve, not replace it with a generic circular dragon. Panel 3 label "收笔 · 游龙冲阵": the paper dragon follows the SAME route forward, crushes only enemy groups on the path with paper fragment impact, one off-path demon untouched. A faint cinnabar trail preserves correspondence. Footer exact short phrase "弯在哪里，就撞到哪里". Show powerful satisfying spectacle while maintaining gameplay readability. Draw approximately consistent large dragon scale across panels; no full-screen explosion obscuring path.

Panel 1 label "勾一段山脊": clearly visible asymmetric three-peak cinnabar line drawn from left to right across upper-middle ground in front of the fox, several paper demons approaching from above. Show slight imperfections and one low and one high peak. Minimal prompt "画高低，定山势". Panel 2 label "纸山立起 · 挡住群妖": folded burgundy-red paper mountains stand up from that exact jagged baseline as a physical barricade, same unequal three peaks, enemies bunch up on far side, one walks around left end; white fox protected on near side. Contact shadows are flat printed graphic shapes. Clearly communicate blocked movement, no decorative background confusion; mountain is in foreground battlefield. Panel 3 label "推山 · 倒向敌群": a single short GOLD player swipe arrow from fox toward the mountain specifies collapse away from fox; same three mountain sections fold/fall forward into a wide paper-rock crushing wave toward clustered enemies, ruins and paper shards stay in the previous wall footprint; fox visibly safe. Footer "先改变战场，再把山势化成大招". Include one tiny annotation "高山更耗墨" with ink gauge decreasing appropriately. DO NOT make arbitrary scribbles become unrelated mountains.

Three-panel comparative storyboard: Panel 1 "纸神待点化": majestic tall ivory and vermilion paper guardian with face mask and empty hands, faint gold weapon socket next to one hand. Add tiny two selectable sample glyphs under panel: simple straight sword line and broad semicircular fan outline. Panel 2 "添长锋 · 一剑断阵": same guardian, player draws a long slightly curved cinnabar blade stroke outward from the hand, that same stroke extends into a huge narrow cut-paper sword. Show a focused forward cleaving slash damaging a tight enemy column. Keep ghost of the drawn blade centerline visible on the sword. Panel 3 "添扇面 · 开扇退敌": an ALTERNATIVE BRANCH, not subsequent action: same guardian in same starting position, simple broad semicircular cinnabar contour attached to hand transforms into a large ornamental paper fan with ribs; wide fan-shaped gust pushes many surrounding demons away, less lethal than sword. Small branch annotations above panels 2 and 3 "分支一" and "分支二". Footer "同一个纸神，你添的形状决定这一招". Giant powerful figure but maintain whole small fox, visible enemies, and clear input-to-weapon connection. No actual handwriting required beyond captions.
